rules.statement: Exactly 25 fame categories are exposed; the PSC comment order is the documented order and the ESP FameType array is the runtime order.

Tattoo and Cum Dump use lowercase ESP names tattoo and cum dump; lookup is case-insensitive. Sex Worker is a separate non-category flag backed by SexWorkerFlags, and the deprecated Whore Event name is its query alias; neither adds a 26th Fame category. GetExternalFlags and DoesFlagExist do not expose either non-category flag.
The listener registers 52 input ModEvents. Event names, handler names, parameter types, parameter order and defaults are part of the compatibility contract.
Seven query reply ModEvents are emitted; each reply Push order is fixed by the handler body.
A query for an unknown location/category returns without sending a reply. Unknown flag or mod queries still send the normal reply with FlagExists=No and a False state.
There are 21 default locations in the fixed ESP order; slots 0-8 are major and slots 9-20 are minor.

Resolve an excluded location/keyword to Null first, then a custom location by registration order, then a minor location, then a major location. Custom and minor accept IsChild or exact name; major accepts IsChild only. Otherwise return Null.
Normalize the six regional aliases before validation: Eastmarch->Windhelm, Haafingar->Solitude, Hjaalmarch->Morthal, the Reach->Markarth, the Pale->Dawnstar, the Rift->Riften. $NoneText is invalid.
Locations in ExcludedLocations or matching an excluded keyword return Null/None and do not become custom fame locations.

Manual spread requires source value >= 10 and clamps percent to 10-100; result is min(150, int(target_old + source_old * (double(percent) / 100.0))). Truncate only the final result. The source must not be modified by this operation.
rules.approvedChange: Fix the legacy integer-division bug: percentages 10-99 must have their normal proportional effect. Source 100, target 20, percent 30 produces 50, not 20. Downstream compatibility does not require reproducing obvious bugs.

rules.statement: Spread and SpreadRoll are one-hop compatibility pulses: use a frozen source snapshot, recompute incoming edges, apply R=max(old R, G_R) on targets, do not cascade and do not decay in the same step.
rules.approvedChange: Replace legacy random propagation with the agreed weighted model while retaining callable Spread/SpreadRoll entry points.

rules.statement: The published/API value is max(local L, remote/diffused R); L and R are stored separately and only R is changed by passive diffusion.
rules.approvedChange: Use the agreed local/imported state model; this is a new implementation rule, not a fact extracted from the old scripts.

rules.statement: An explicit Set writes the supplied value without a global 0-150 clamp. Manual gain and automatic gain cap results at 150; manual decrease floors at zero; manual spread caps its result at 150. In the new L/R model, an explicit V sets L=V and R=min(R,V).

Wipe clears the selected category values once and is not a continuing zeroing policy. Cum Dump, Cuck, Unfaithful and Airhead are optional cleanup categories inside the same 25-category numeric array; optional means they can be selected for cleanup, not that they are separate from the 25 categories.
Multiple registered mods contribute flags by OR. A single mod contribution is addressed by plugin name plus flag name; removing a mod clears that mod contribution and re-evaluates derived flags.
Register a mod only when Game.GetModByName(ModName) != 255; ignore duplicates; count non-empty slots. Unregister clears all flags and Enable* entries for that slot before re-evaluation.

Public records are identified by plugin SLSF Reloaded.esp, editor ID and required VMAD script bindings. A file FormID such as 0x06000808 contains the file's master index 0x06; its local object ID is 0x000808. Persistent keys use plugin name plus local object ID, not that file index or a runtime load-order prefix. No ABI address is part of the contract.
source: SLSF Reloaded.esp:58 records (4 QUST, 1 MGEF, 1 SPEL, 10 KYWD, 42 GLOB)

rules.statement: The old MCM and its Papyrus menu are excluded; the new configuration menu uses the SKSE menu framework. No MCM Papyrus script is required.
rules.approvedChange: MCM Papyrus source is absent; the new UI uses the SKSE menu framework, so the MCM screen is not preserved as a Papyrus contract.

rules.statement: Legacy internal arrays, properties and helper functions are not compatibility commitments. Only the declared public API surface and event protocol are frozen.
rules.approvedChange: The 483 internal properties/arrays are implementation details; only public API functions, events, categories and location behavior are preserved.

rules.statement: Persisted state is versioned native co-save data for new saves only; no legacy Papyrus array, VMAD or old-save state is imported.
rules.approvedChange: Legacy save import is intentionally unsupported; the C++ persistent state starts with defaults in a new save.

rules.statement: One core executor processes state mutations. No business thread pool is allowed; ports may hand off to the game/VM thread, and tests may use threads.

A single AVX2 numerical implementation stores double values for 25 categories in 32 slots: 4 doubles per 256-bit vector, 8 vectors per 256-byte row, and 7 masked padding slots. Scalar reference code exists only in tests.
Do not record guessed addresses or ABI offsets; runtime verification belongs to a later group and must be marked not run when the game environment is absent.
